text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Saturn is exactly eighty light-minutes
away from
this very spot... Assuming a
ten-centimeter
diameter, that's the
equivalent of lining up 140
million
donuts.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Easy-peasy! If I go all out, I can make
that
distance in two days!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
YOU! Get ready for lift off! Prepare the

emergency donuts!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
After all, when the going gets tough, the
tough
need donuts...
